slides.title: Kacha and Mastercard: what is in the new deal?
A five-year agreement
slides.body: Kacha Digital Financial Service will issue payment cards directly to its own customers, The Reporter reports.

slides.title: Open to other institutions
slides.body: Kacha also plans card-issuing services for eligible banks, microfinance institutions and fintechs, subject to regulatory approvals.

slides.title: Not yet stated
slides.body: Fees, launch date and which institutions have signed were not given. Awash Bank and Commercial Bank of Ethiopia already offer Mastercard-linked cards.

slides.title: More choice in payments, with clear rules and fees.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
